products.name: Deploy Microsoft Sentinel — Workspace, Data Connectors & Ingestion — Commercial
products.short_description: Stand up Microsoft Sentinel the right way — a governed Log Analytics workspace, the right data connectors, and cost-aware ingestion.
products.description:
Stand up Microsoft Sentinel the right way — a governed Log Analytics workspace, the right data connectors, and cost-aware ingestion.

Most Sentinel deployments start by clicking Enable and connecting everything — then drown in noise and cost. This solution builds Sentinel on a properly sized Log Analytics workspace, connects the high-value data sources (Entra, Defender, Office 365, Azure Activity, syslog/CEF), and sets ingestion up so you collect what detections actually need.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Workspace design & RBAC — a right-sized Log Analytics workspace with least-privilege access
  • Connector plan — Entra ID, Defender XDR, Office 365, Azure Activity, AMA/DCR syslog & CEF
  • Data collection rules (DCRs) that filter noise before it costs you
  • Table plan (Analytics vs Basic/Auxiliary logs) and retention/archive strategy
  • Health monitoring — connector health, ingestion drift, and gap detection

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A production-ready Sentinel foundation collecting the right data at a controlled cost — ready for detections and automation.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • SENTDEP-Discovery.ps1 — discover the current Sentinel workspace, connectors, DCRs, tables and retention (read-only)
    • SENTDEP-Report.ps1 — report ingestion volume, projected cost, connector health and ingestion drift via KQL (read-only)
    • SENTDEP-Set-Diagnostics.ps1 — preview/apply the Entra ID and Azure Activity diagnostic routing to the workspace (-WhatIf default)
    • SENTDEP-Set-Retention.ps1 — preview/apply the table plan: log tier (Analytics vs Basic/Auxiliary) and retention/archive per table (-WhatIf default)
    • SENTDEP-Validate.ps1 — check the Sentinel foundation against the 05-testing.md pass/fail gates (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
